classification.summary: Add a hosted decision model that produces a per-scan verdict from scanner-derived data only
key_findings: Hosted model produces verdict from scanner-derived counts and rule IDs only
Deterministic policy is fallback and floor
Section 2 item 1 constraint forbids feeding target descriptions to LLM
Typed input (enum and integer fields only) makes it impossible to send target text
Trade-off: model cannot find risks that rules miss; adds external network dependency
classification.decision_rationale: Model never sees target text, keeping Section 2 item 1 compliance. Policy floor means model error can only make verdict stricter.
